mapper.select: SELECT email, code_hash AS codeHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, resend_available_at AS resendAvailableAt, failed_attempts AS failedAttempts FROM auth_email_verification_codes WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_email_verification_codes ( email, code_hash, expires_at, resend_available_at, failed_attempts ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{resendAvailableAt}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_email_verification_codes SET code_hash = #{codeHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, resend_available_at = #{resendAvailableAt}, failed_attempts = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE auth_email_verification_codes SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email}
